logs.text: I got my shot to direct a film and chose to make an action movie.

scenarios.Title: Evaders of the Lost Ark
scenarios.Body:
You received a script for a movie called 'Evaders of the Lost Ark,' and must decide who should play the lead.

It's a film about an archeology professor who is hired to find the Ark of the Cavemen before an evil organization retrieves what's inside it: an artifact that can make an army shoot beams from their pinkies.
